decision: Rejected: reusing register-analysis arrays plus earlier scalar-parameter rejection did not show a compiler latency improvement in the pilot; no compiler change was accepted.

compilation.sample_order: Alternating for two variants; rotating positions and direction for three or more.
compilation.cpu_time_definition: User + system CPU seconds for the compiler and its waited-for children; may exceed wall time with multiple emission workers.

runtime_certificate_integration.sample_order: Rotating positions and direction; identical artifacts share explicitly labeled samples when enabled.

unchanged_runtime_proof.evidence: candidate matches the previous artifact; that artifact matches the accepted stage after masking equal-width bundle/input paths, with identical workload and harness sources

limits: Native 64-bit host. Warm filesystem caches; one build per binary.
C graph uses flat edges and a handwritten map; Dewy uses per-node arrays and an insertion-ordered map.
String equality uses separately allocated payloads; C uses pointer/length pairs and libc memcmp, Dewy uses runtime strings.
Kernel times exclude input generation; wall times include the complete process.
Thread CPU timing excludes descheduling, but CPU frequency and cache contention still matter.

validation.runtime_certificate_integration: Fresh native default/release binaries matched the accepted stage; every variant passed boundary and full-size checks. Runtime samples are empty, not historical timings.
